observations.behavior: Adds a placeholderData callback to the React Query configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: This could support optimistic UI updates or caching of previously fetched artifact previews without re-fetching on every render. This matters for perceived performance and responsiveness in PostHog's desktop app when users switch between versions.

observations.behavior: Returns an additional boolean flag indicating whether data came from cached/placeholder sources rather than fresh network requests.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows components like ArtifactPreview to distinguish between live and cached state, potentially enabling better loading indicators or version-switching behavior while preserving existing cached results.

observations.behavior: Disables older-version navigation controls if no valid cached data exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides immediate feedback to users that switching back to an older version isn't possible because it hasn't been loaded yet, improving UX consistency during async operations.

observations.limitations: All hunks are confined to P1 and P2; this chunk does not demonstrate broader systemic benefit across other PostHog services, nor does it show end-to-end recovery or shared dependency handling. No tier-3 evidence.

review.limitations: All hunks are confined to P1 and P2; this chunk does not demonstrate broader systemic benefit across other PostHog services, nor does it show end-to-end recovery or shared dependency handling. No tier-3 evidence.
review.reason: Adds a bounded capability: placeholder-based caching and its associated metadata. The implementation and checks are visible, but the change remains localized to one component and its query hook without demonstrated wider impact.
review.posthog_relevance: Could improve perceived responsiveness of artifact preview switching in Desktop, though adoption and actual benefit remain unverified.
review.uncertainty: This chunk lacks tests for failure paths or cross-service dependencies; could be narrow maintenance rather than substantive improvement.
